results.question: Which solvent was selected as optimal for the aerobic oxidation of 3-(n-hexyl)-1,2-octadien-4-ol in the optimization studies (Table 1 and related text)?
results.ground_truth: 1,2-Dichloroethane (DCE) was selected as the optimal solvent.
results.system_answer: The optimal solvent for the aerobic oxidation of 3-(n-hexyl)-1,2-octadien-4-ol was DCE (1,2-dichloroethane). In the solvent screening (Table 1), DCE gave the highest conversion (75%) and NMR yield (43%) at room temperature, outperforming DCM (25% yield), toluene (21%), THF (19%), and other solvents (evidence: block_1_0015). The general optimized procedure later in the paper also uses DCE as the solvent, consistent with the screening results (evidence: block_1_0046).
results.judge_reasoning: The system answer correctly identifies DCE as the optimal solvent, includes the substrate name, and mentions both DCE and 1,2-dichloroethane, perfectly matching the ground truth and all key entities.
